title: Supersampling Stable Diffusion and Beyond: Training-Free Neural Network Scaling via Signal Interpolation
abstract: arXiv:2605.08698v4 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: This work presents a training-free approach for interpolating neural networks using signal interpolation methods (i.e., linear, bilinear, bicubic). We discovered this phenomenon while attempting to interpolate the convolution layers of Stable-Diffusion-1.5 for beyond-training-resolution (BTR) image generation. As we know, for generating BTR images using DDPMs (Denoising Diffusion Probabilistic Models), there are mainly two approaches, namely, 1) patch-wise diffusion and 2) convolution-kernel dilation. Patch-wise diffusion cannot solve the object-duplication problem efficiently, while the kernel dilation approach may be harder to fine-tune later. Thus, we proposed convolution-kernel interpolation of the Stable Diffusion 1.5 model for $4\times$ BTR image generation. translated_title: 超采样稳定扩散及更多：基于信号插值的免训练神经网络缩放方法
translated_abstract: 本文提出了一种使用信号插值方法（即线性、双线性、双三次插值）对神经网络进行插值的免训练方法。我们在尝试对Stable-Diffusion-1.5的卷积层进行插值以实现超出训练分辨率（BTR）图像生成时发现了这一现象。众所周知，使用DDPM（去噪扩散概率模型）生成超出训练分辨率的图像主要有两种方法：1）分块扩散和2）卷积核膨胀。分块扩散无法有效解决对象重复问题，而卷积核膨胀方法在后续微调时可能更加困难。因此，我们提出了对Stable Diffusion 1.5模型进行卷积核插值，以实现4倍超出训练分辨率的图像生成。我们通过数学方式发现并证明，当乘以一个平坦衰减因子时，信号插值方法可以正确地缩放卷积核，同时实现……
tldr: 提出了一种免训练的卷积核信号插值方法，使Stable Diffusion 1.5无需额外训练即可生成4倍于训练分辨率的图像，同时避免了分块扩散的对象重复问题和核膨胀的微调困难。
en_tdlr: Proposes a training-free signal interpolation approach for convolution kernels, enabling Stable Diffusion 1.5 to generate images at 4× beyond its training resolution while avoiding object duplication and fine-tuning difficulties of existing methods.
